subject: Mentorship Summit — request for maintainer / mentor credits and trial extension
content:
From: Elena Torres <elena@openmentors.org>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mentorship Summit — request for maintainer / mentor credits and trial extension

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for speaking with me yesterday about Redwood sponsoring our Mentorship Summit (June 10–11). We run a small non-profit that helps project maintainers connect with mentors and companies that can provide compute/credits for open-source work. For the summit we expect ~40 maintainers (mostly small repos) and ~20 mentors from companies.

Two quick asks: could Redwood provide a set of credits for maintainers to try dedicated inference during the summit (we usually hand out 100–500 USD equivalent per project) and a 30-day trial extension for maintainers who start evaluation accounts at the event? We want the credits to be redeemable by maintainers and trackable so we can report back on outcomes (adoption, follow-ups).

I attached a short sponsorship proposal and the provisional mentor roster. If helpful, Ravi (cc’d) can share the program schedule.

Appreciate any flexibility — we’ve sent Redwood users several high-quality leads in the past and I think this audience aligns well with your maintainer-first positioning.

Best,
Elena Torres
Community Director, OpenMentors
[attachment: mentorship-summit-proposal.pdf (application/pdf)]
[attachment: mentor-roster-2027.csv (text/csv)]

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@openmentors.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mentorship Summit — request for maintainer / mentor credits and trial extension

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for sending the materials. Saw the roster and the schedule; this looks like a very targeted group.

Two items I’ll check with the team:
- Whether we can allocate a trackable credit bundle for maintainers (we typically mint promo codes tied to an account/claim flow).
- If we can apply a 30-day trial extension for accounts created via the summit campaign.

Looping in Marissa (growth partnerships) and Monica (program ops) to confirm constraints and the approval path. If you have a simple claim flow or a landing page you want us to link to, please share.

I’ll aim to get you a yes/no and proposed amounts by EOD tomorrow.

— Marcus
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mentorship Summit — request for maintainer / mentor credits and trial extension

Marcus / Monica — quick intake:
- We should treat this as a small partner promo (non-sales lead gen). Budget ask: ~$15k USD in credits to cover 30–40 maintainers at ~350 USD equivalent each, plus a set-aside for mentor trials (up to 5 accounts at 1k each for deeper eval).
- Operationally, we can issue promo codes scoped to an org email domain or to a claim link. For reporting, suggest unique HubSpot campaign + a Drive spreadsheet for claim tracking.
- Compliance check: no PII in the claim flow; we should require GitHub repo URL and contact email.

If Marcus signs off, I’ll draft an approval note and the HubSpot campaign.

— Marissa
Growth Partnerships, Redwood Inference

---

From: Elena Torres <elena@openmentors.org>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi@openmentors.org>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mentorship Summit — request for maintainer / mentor credits and trial extension

Thanks Marcus & Marissa — that budget estimate is in line with what we were thinking. For reporting we can require redeeming maintainers to provide their repo and a short 200-word description of intended experiments; we’ll share a post-event outcomes doc.

Quick clarifications:
- If maintainers already have Redwood accounts, can the promo apply to their existing orgs? If not, we’ll instruct them to claim a new evaluation account and then transfer learnings with you after the summit.
- Any restrictions on code/usage? (e.g., commercial usage allowed during trial?)

Attaching a one-page claim flow draft for your ops team to review.

Best,
Elena

[attachment: claim-flow-onepager.pdf (application/pdf)]

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@openmentors.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mentorship Summit — request for maintainer / mentor credits and trial extension

Elena — good news. Approved:
- Promo allocation: $12,500 USD in redeemable credits for maintainers (we’ll issue 25 codes at $500 each and 5 codes at $250 each; you can decide distribution).
- Mentor trials: 4 mentor accounts with a 30-day trial extension (1,000 USD equivalent cap each).
- Trial rules: promo credits are redeemable for hosted API and embeddings; limited to non-production eval workloads. Commercial use during the trial is permitted for evaluation purposes only; we’ll need to review if teams move to sustained production usage.

Operational notes:
- I created HubSpot campaign RDW-PRM-4821 and a claim sheet at the linked Drive file. Marissa — can you finalize the promo codes and the claim flow emails (templated welcome + redemption instructions)? Monica — can you confirm the code scoping (org/domain vs single-use)?

Elena — please confirm the distribution plan and whether maintainers who already have Redwood org accounts should request a code to be attached to their existing orgs (we can support that). Once you confirm, we’ll send the codes and the welcome email the week before the summit.

Happy to reinforce the program on our community channels if you’d like.

— Marcus
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference

[HubSpot campaign: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/0000000/company/123456789]
[Drive claim sheet: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcdEFg/view]
